profile.summary: Jacobson Education Law is a law practice in Berkeley, California. It represents families in education law matters for school-age children, including special education cases involving individualized education programs (IEPs) and Section 504 plans. It does not take college or post-secondary cases.

The site says the firm represents families (not districts), which is an unusual fit for a district contract, but the name/city/specialty combination is distinctive and the summary states it accurately. orgType 'company' is not shown by any source and is dropped.
